dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when you first started noticing these involuntary movements and the difficulty swallowing?

The movements and the trouble swallowing just started getting bad this past month. Before that, for about a year, I've mainly been feeling so restless and hearing voices that aren't there. It’s hard to even talk clearly sometimes, and I just feel so irritable.
I see; that sounds very distressing. Does anyone in your family have a history of similar movement issues or psychiatric conditions?

Well, my father struggled with his mental health and ended up taking his own life when he was only fifty. I'm not really sure if he had these same twitches, but he was definitely going through a hard time like I am. I just feel so confused and forgetful lately, and it's making everything harder.
I am very sorry to hear about your father. Are you currently taking any medications for the voices you've been hearing, and have you noticed any changes in your coordination or balance?

I haven't been taking anything for the voices yet, and I'm not really sure about my balance. I just know I'm restless and these jerking movements make me feel like I can't control my own body anymore. It's all so confusing, and I've been losing my way with things I used to know how to do.

I understand. Can you describe the jerking movements in more detail—do they happen all the time, and do they affect your whole body? 

REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain
